claim_boundary: Mapped cross-implementation evidence does not make ngspice an oracle or turn reduced-order cases into production device models.

cases.title: RC step response
cases.engineering_question: Does the mapped capacitor charging transient preserve the declared resistance, capacitance, source, and initial state?

cases.title: RC stored-energy discharge
cases.engineering_question: Does an initially charged capacitor discharge consistently through the mapped resistor without an independent source?

cases.title: Sinusoidally driven RC filter
cases.engineering_question: Do both implementations reproduce the declared sinusoidal forcing, attenuation, and phase-lag trend?

cases.title: PWL current-driven RC network
cases.engineering_question: Does a piecewise-linear current command create the same resistor-capacitor state trajectory and event times?

cases.title: RL current buildup
cases.engineering_question: Does the mapped inductor current rise consistently under the declared voltage and resistance?

cases.title: RL stored-current decay
cases.engineering_question: Does a nonzero initial inductor current decay consistently through the mapped resistor?

cases.title: Lossless LC oscillation
cases.engineering_question: How closely do mapped lossless trajectories agree when phase and energy drift accumulate over many steps?

cases.title: LC mixed initial-condition oscillation
cases.engineering_question: Does the mapping preserve simultaneous initial capacitor voltage and inductor current?

cases.title: Underdamped parallel RLC decay
cases.engineering_question: Do the implementations agree on oscillatory decay when resistance removes stored energy?

cases.title: Overdamped parallel RLC decay
cases.engineering_question: Do both solvers preserve the non-oscillatory overdamped regime?

cases.title: Driven series RLC network
cases.engineering_question: Does sinusoidal forcing produce consistent inductor-current and capacitor-voltage states in a loaded RLC network?

cases.title: Diode clipper
cases.engineering_question: Does the Shockley-diode mapping reproduce the same nonlinear clipping trend?

cases.title: Capacitor-loaded diode rectifier
cases.engineering_question: Do both nonlinear solvers reproduce charging pulses and load discharge in a reduced rectifier?

cases.title: Diode bias-transition clamp
cases.engineering_question: Does a piecewise-linear bias reversal produce consistent clamp and recovery behavior?

cases.title: Scheduled switched RC network
cases.engineering_question: Are switch transitions aligned and mapped with the same on and off resistances?

cases.title: Scheduled switched RL network
cases.engineering_question: Do the mapped switch and freewheel path preserve inductor-current continuity across scheduled events?

cases.title: Scheduled switched RLC network
cases.engineering_question: Do both implementations reproduce event-driven energy transfer between an inductor and capacitor?

cases.title: Simplified buck-like converter
cases.engineering_question: Does the semantic mapping preserve the scheduled switch, freewheel diode, inductor, capacitor, and load response?

cases.title: Scheduled H-bridge RL load
cases.engineering_question: Do four scheduled switches produce a consistent bipolar RL-load current trajectory?

cases.title: DC-link RLC startup and interruption
cases.engineering_question: Does the mapping preserve startup, interruption, freewheel behavior, and link-energy transients?
